name: Cotton Fabrics
tagline: Poplin, twill and canvas for shirting, uniforms and workwear
summary: Yunhong supplies combed cotton poplin, twill and canvas from 110 to 340 gsm, OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certified, with 300 m minimums and 18–28 day production.
intro: Our cotton range is built around three constructions that cover most apparel programmes: fine poplin for shirting, mid-weight twill for chinos and uniforms, and heavy canvas for bags, jackets and workwear. All cotton is combed and ring-spun, so the yarn is cleaner and the surface pills less than carded alternatives at the same price point.

Greige fabric is woven in Keqiao and finished in-house, which keeps shade consistency tight across repeat orders. Piece-dyed shades are matched to your lab dip, and we hold 40 stock colours ready for 100 m sample orders.
imageAlt: Folded stacks of ivory and sand cotton poplin fabric in a textile studio
highlights: Combed, ring-spun yarn for a clean surface
GOTS organic cotton available on 1,000 m+

faqs.question: What is the minimum order for cotton fabric?
faqs.answer: 300 metres per colour for custom dyeing, or 100 metres per colour from our stock shade card. Sample lengths of 5–20 metres are available before you commit to bulk.

faqs.question: Can you supply GOTS certified organic cotton?
faqs.answer: Yes. GOTS organic cotton poplin and twill are available from 1,000 metres per colour with a full transaction certificate chain, typically adding 10–14 days to production.

name: Linen Fabrics
tagline: Washed, blended and heavy linen with European flax
summary: European flax linen in 160–280 gsm, garment-washed for softness, supplied from 300 m with OEKO-TEX certification and heat-friendly breathability for EU, US and Gulf markets.
intro: We weave with certified European flax from Normandy and Belgium, then garment-wash or enzyme-soften the finished cloth so it drapes from the first wear rather than after ten washes. The slub character is part of the look: we grade for evenness so your cutting room sees consistent width and shrinkage.

Linen is our strongest category for the Middle East, where breathability and coverage matter more than crease resistance. We also stock linen-cotton and linen-viscose blends that reduce cost and creasing while keeping the dry hand feel.
imageAlt: Washed natural flax linen fabric draped over pale stone
highlights: Blends with cotton, viscose and wool

faqs.question: Is your linen pre-shrunk?
faqs.answer: Yes. Garment-washed linen is pre-shrunk to under 3% residual shrinkage in both warp and weft, and we issue a shrinkage report with every bulk shipment so your pattern maker can cut confidently.

faqs.question: Where does the flax come from?
faqs.answer: Flax fibre is sourced from certified European growers in Normandy and Belgium, spun in Jiangsu, and woven at our Keqiao mill. Fibre origin documentation is available for EUDR and brand traceability requests.

name: Denim & Chambray
tagline: Rigid, stretch and selvedge denim from 6 to 14.5 oz
summary: Indigo denim from 6 to 14.5 oz including comfort stretch and selvedge, with rope-dyed yarns, 500 m minimums and 25–35 day production for jeans and jackets.
intro: Our denim is woven on shuttle and projectile looms with rope-dyed indigo yarns, which is why the fade character holds up after repeated washing. We keep a wide weight band so one supplier can cover 5-pocket jeans, trucker jackets, skirts and lightweight chambray shirting.

Stretch qualities use dual-core yarns with 1–3% elastane and are tested for growth and recovery after 5,000 abrasion cycles. If you need a specific % elongation or leg-twist tolerance, send the target figures with your enquiry and we will match the construction.
imageAlt: Rolls of indigo selvedge denim stacked in a weaving mill

faqs.question: What is the minimum order for custom denim?
faqs.answer: 500 metres per colour for custom indigo shades, or 300 metres from our stock indigo and black qualities. Selvedge programmes start at 1,000 metres because of loom setup time.

faqs.question: Do you offer laser-engraving ready denim?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can supply denim with a finish optimised for laser fading, which cuts water use in your laundry by up to 60%. Tell us your laser recipe and we will adjust the finish recipe to suit.

name: Knitted Fabrics
tagline: Jersey, rib and French terry on circular knitting machines
summary: Circular-knit single jersey, rib and French terry from 140 to 320 gsm, with combed cotton and recycled polyester options, 300 m minimums and 15–25 day lead times.
intro: Knits are produced on 24–34 inch circular machines with combed cotton, viscose and recycled polyester yarns. Tubular or open-width, with a compacted finish so the fabric arrives close to final measurements and your cut yield is predictable.

We test every lot for course and wale density, spirality and shrinkage after three home launderings. For heavyweight hoodie programmes we recommend 280–320 gsm French terry with a brushed or looped back, depending on whether you want a soft interior or a dry hand.
imageAlt: Close-up of oatmeal cotton jersey knit fabric with soft folds
highlights: Combed cotton and GRS recycled polyester
Open width or tubular on request

faqs.question: What is the difference between jersey and French terry?
faqs.answer: Single jersey is a lightweight single-faced knit, usually 140–180 gsm, used for T-shirts. French terry is a heavier double-knit with loops on the back, usually 240–320 gsm, used for sweatshirts and hoodies because it holds shape and warmth.

faqs.question: Can you knit with recycled yarn?
faqs.answer: Yes. GRS-certified recycled cotton and recycled polyester yarns are available across jersey, rib and French terry, with transaction certificates issued for each shipment.

name: Viscose & Rayon
tagline: Challis, crepe and blends with a fluid, cool drape
summary: Viscose challis, crepe and linen blends from 100 to 170 gsm, with fluid drape and cool hand feel, ideal for dresses and modest wear in hot climates, from 300 m.
intro: Viscose is the workhorse for warm-weather womenswear: it takes print beautifully, falls softly and feels cool against the skin. We finish with a tensionless wash so the cloth does not pull at the seams, and we test for shrinkage after both hand wash and dry clean.

Our viscose-linen and viscose-crepe qualities add body and reduce the creasing that pure viscose shows in humid conditions — a practical choice for Gulf and Mediterranean markets. All viscose is FSC-controlled pulp and OEKO-TEX certified.
imageAlt: Flowing sand-coloured viscose fabric caught in motion
highlights: Print-ready with digital and rotary options

faqs.question: Does viscose shrink a lot?
faqs.answer: Standard viscose can shrink 5–8% on first wash. Our finishes are tensionless-washed and pre-shrunk to 3–4%, and we recommend a 3% cutting allowance for unwashed styles.

faqs.question: Can you print on viscose?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer digital reactive printing from 100 m and rotary printing from 1,000 m, with colour matching to Pantone TCX. Digital lead time is 12–16 days including strike-off approval.

name: Recycled & Performance
tagline: GRS recycled polyester, nylon taslan and 3-layer softshell
summary: GRS-certified recycled polyester and nylon performance fabrics, plus 3-layer softshell, with waterproof ratings to 10,000 mm and 300 m minimums for EU and US brands.
intro: This range exists for brands that have committed to recycled content and need documentation, not just a claim. We buy GRS-certified recycled chips and yarns, keep transaction certificates on file, and issue them with the shipping documents so your sustainability claim survives an audit.

Constructions cover recycled polyester twill for outerwear and bags, recycled nylon taslan for lightweight shells, and a 3-layer softshell with a TPU membrane for ski and cycling programmes. PFC-free DWR is standard; bluesign-approved finishes are available.
imageAlt: Water beading on deep olive recycled polyester performance fabric

faqs.question: Do you provide GRS transaction certificates?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every recycled shipment includes a GRS transaction certificate covering the yarn lot and the delivered metres, so the recycled content claim can be traced through your supply chain.

faqs.question: Is the water repellency PFC-free?
faqs.answer: Yes, C0 PFC-free DWR is standard across the performance range, with a spray rating of 4–5 after 20 home launderings. Fluorocarbon finishes are available on request where a contract requires them.
